events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; (cd app && node scripts/probe-kept-tools.mjs > /tmp/t260-kept.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?); grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/t260-kept.log; grep '^FAIL' /tmp/t260-kept.log | head; tail -2 /tmp/t260-kept.log | cut -c1-200; echo ---survey; grep -n -o -i -E '.{60}(beehiiv|\bNotion\b|wordpress|expandi|sales ?navigator|vercel|fireflies).{40}' workshop-plan/survey.html | head -5; cmp workshop-plan/survey.html app/public/materials/survey.html && echo same; echo ---logos; git grep -n -E 'obsstudio|tools/vercel|tools/wordpress' -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/build | head -
